name: Farhad Novian
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Los Angeles, California
side_practice_areas: Business Litigation, Business & Corporate, Employment & Labor
about: For over three decades, Farhad Novian, the managing partner at Novian & Novian, LLP, in Los Angeles, California, has been a guiding force for businesses and individuals navigating a wide array of corporate and business transactions, along with related disputes. His adept handling of cases, whether resolved through court trials, jury verdicts, arbitration, mediation or informal means, has been pivotal at both state and federal levels. Leading a talented team of corporate, litigation and transactional attorneys, he ensures his clients receive quality legal services at competitive rates.

An accomplished professional, Mr. Novian possesses a remarkable talent for navigating the intricate world of business advisory and legal battles, unraveling complicated matters related to trade secrets, business deceit, intellectual property, employment, licensing, partnerships and real estate. His skillful advocacy benefits both privately owned and publicly listed companies as he steers them through various transactional journeys. These ventures span industries such as corporate, entertainment, hospitality, real estate and technology, covering everything from early funding to day-to-day operations and through the complexities of mergers and acquisitions.

Mr. Novian's academic journey began with a Bachelor of Arts in economics and political science from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) in 1981, followed by a Juris Doctor from Loyola Law School, Los Angeles, in 1984. In 1988, he co-launched Novian & Novian, LLP, with his brother. Admitted to practice in California in 1985, he is also authorized to appear before the U.S. District Courts for the Northern, Southern, Eastern and Central Districts of California and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit.

Throughout his career, Mr. Novian has consistently achieved favorable outcomes for his clients through mediation, arbitration and litigation, earning high regard from his peers. His accolades include an AV* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, recognizing his exceptional legal skills and ethics, along with a "Superb" rating from Avvo.

Beyond his legal practice, Mr. Novian actively engages with several professional organizations, such as the American Bar Association, the Los Angeles County Bar Association, the Beverly Hills Bar Association and the International Trademark Association. He frequently shares his insights as a lecturer at UCLA, particularly on topics related to hospitality and real estate law.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
